تستعملن (form X)

# تُسْتَعْمَلْنَ (tustaʕmalna) /tus.taʕ.mal.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْمَلَ (istaʕmala)
